subject: scoping of variables across different Server functions - multiple re-assignment per session

messages.author: 2ef256a129b97763
messages.subject: scoping of variables across different Server functions - multiple re-assignment per session
parts:
Hi.  I struggle to explain in simple words my problem, so please bear with me (and apologies for my poor English!).

I have developed a simulation application with shiny app (available at https://smartinsightsfromdata.shinyapps.io/TCleveland/).  

The app simulate a complex supply / demand  workflow mapped through different tabsetpanels (the workflow is covered navigating to "Impact on Resources" / CID).

Each "stage" / panel of the workflow modify a component (e.g. supply; demand etc.). Ideally, the user will be able to start from any point (panel) of the workflow and finish the simulation exercise in any other point (panel).

Each stage / panel is centred around a ggplot2 graph & sliders that modify a local copy of a global variable and ultimately re-assign the modified value to the global variable (using <<-) so that the result is available to other stages / panels.

Sadly I noticed that  the global variable is copied locally only once per session, while I need this to happen every time.  In other words, the results obtained in a panel need to be passed to all the other panels. At the moment this happens only the first time that the panel is executed.

What should I do?
